# Local raw LDD snapshot — 2026-09-18

Official index pages and six province archives are cached here with URL, UTC timestamp, SHA-256 and byte count in paired `.source.json` files.
See `../../regional_orchards/SOURCE_TH.md` for exact URLs, snapshot years, encodings, CRS, limitations and publication restrictions.
Run `tools/fetch_regional_ldd.py` from the project root to reproduce downloads/extraction. Requires 7-Zip.
Raw archives and extracted GIS data are intentionally excluded from Git; do not publish pending redistribution review.
